nft.name: Robinhood NFT
nft.description: Any ERC-721 or ERC-1155 NFT on Robinhood Chain stocked inside a player-created prize machine. The winner keeps the NFT, or takes the USDG backing the creator attached to it.

createMachine.label: Open a prize machine
createMachine.description: Stock a new machine with any Robinhood Chain NFTs and USDG prizes, set its pull price and its finite ticket deck, and put it on the arcade floor. The creator receives 95% of every pull.

pull.label: Pull the lever
pull.description: One ticket from the selected machine's finite deck. Win a stocked NFT, a USDG prize, or nothing. The platform keeps 5% of the pull.

keepPrize.label: Keep the NFT
keepPrize.description: Keep a won NFT and move it to your Friend wallet. Its USDG backing returns to the machine creator.

claimBacking.label: Take the backing
claimBacking.description: Take the USDG backing a creator attached to a won NFT. The NFT returns to its creator instead of being burned.

withdrawMachine.label: Collect creator receipts
withdrawMachine.description: Move the 95% creator share of every pull made on one of your machines into your wallet.

pauseMachine.label: Pause machine
pauseMachine.description: Take one of your machines off the floor without emptying it. Resume it whenever you like.

resumeMachine.label: Resume machine
resumeMachine.description: Put a paused machine back on the floor.

cancelMachine.label: Cancel machine
cancelMachine.description: Before its first pull, empty a machine: the USDG prize pool and backing are refunded and its NFTs return to your owner wallet.
